reviews.x: Love these lashes I was looking for a good magnetic lashes and this one right here is great

my only complaint is the eyeliner is DRY. it might work for a couple of seconds and dry out and i have to use the other liner and consistency swap them and also it does not give a nice sharp wing like i usually like so what i do is that i’d use a typical liquid liner to draw my tip then fill in my lash line with the magic liner which works phenomenally. the adhesion is AMAZING and stays practically all day like hun, i took a nap with these things on and they stayed on like i never slept. as long

I've hated false eyelashes and was skeptical about these but I said eff it why not. And as soon as they got here I tried it on my hand and sure enough it worked. I have a small set face so I had to cut them a little to fit but Amazing too put on. Light and doesn't fly off. I have allergies to a lot of things and my eyes didn't seem to react with the eyeliner. Soo that's another big plus.  I highly recommend you spending the money one these. I'll be purchasing more liner.

reviews.t: Does everything it states! Cute too!
reviews.x: I really love these lashes!. So easy to put on. The eyeliner is REALLY water & smudge proof.  It is a little difficult to take all of the eyeliner off with just hot/warm water. There's a lot of rubbing involved 😑. But over all they are my new go to lashes. Buy buy buy!

reviews.t: Had high hopes, but not so much
reviews.x: I really wanted to like this product and I had high hopes but it fell flat because of the eyeliner. I received the package and decided to use the lashes about 2 wks after receiving them. Why did the first eyeliner seem almost dried up?? The lashes barely stayed on. I had to use the 2nd liner which was probably the way the first one was meant to be. The first one just dried out in 1 mins. Disappointing!! Also the liner is very difficult to take off. Unfortunately I cannot recommend this to my fol

reviews.t: Lashes are sharp and stabbed my eyes, glue dries out after 1 use.
reviews.x: These eyelashes stabbed my eyes so badly. It hurt, and itched and made my eyes water so badly i had to take them off before we could even go out. They are also EXTREMELY dramatic - so if that isn't the look you are going for, beware. As for the glue, packaging was adorable and I had very high hopes. It worked incredibly the first use and I told everyone about it. Unfortunately, one use is all you get before it loses all stick and my lashes wouldn't even adhere. You get what you pay for I suppose

Not what I expected at all. I usually use the magnetic kind. And I thought these were the same. But I guess I didn’t look carefully enough. They just don’t hold or stick as well as the magnetic kind. The eyeliner is kinda hard to take off too. I’d recommend finding another brand. Which is sad because when I opened it, I was so excited. The lashes looked great, packaging was great, and even the eyeliner was bedazzled! But alas, I’ll have to buy elsewhere. 🥺

reviews.t: Best false lashes I’ve ever bought
reviews.x: These are the easiest false lashes I’ve ever applied. You just apply the eyeliner and put the lashes on, on top of the eyeliner. I use to pay $120 a month for eyelash extensions but these are a lot less expensive and it kills two birds with one stone. You have eyeliner and eyelashes in one go. I 10/10 recommend and will buy again. I’ve already convinced my sister to buy a set. If you’re considering getting these just go for it they’re worth it!

Update (4th or 5th order) These new lashes aren't soft like they used to be. They're stiff and won't stay on.  My new favorite lashes! They're thick and pretty. I'm terrible at putting on lashes but these was easy to put on and they lasted longer than I thought they would. The magnetic glue is very strong. Will definitely be ordering again

Love these lashes! They are so easy to put on and comfortable to wear. I have used a pair 3 times already, the magnetic eyeliner is so easy to use and it has a felt pointy tip which is a plus. I can’t wait to purchase other styles to try. These have made my everyday look much faster. I don’t have to wait for any glue to get tacky or dry.

reviews.t: I'm obsessed!!! Omg it works so good
reviews.x: I was skeptical, i have used magnetic, glue, I've done eyelash extensions, and I'm pretty good with all of them but this??!! So so easy and holds all day!! Great for sensitive eyes! I ordered one dramatic set and I'm gonna order 4 more now, i just hope they get more styles to choose from. I am not kidding, love these.

reviews.t: Best magnetic eyelashes I have ever tried!
reviews.x: I love how light these lashes feel. I noticed most magnetic lashes are super heavy... these are not. The applicator is more like a marker pen than a liquid liner. The reason I gave this four starts was the ends lift up after a long day or a super warm/sweaty day. They do look great and I get lots of compliments.

Paid $20.00 for 2 fancy looking empty eyeliner cases. Both of the eyeliners were dried out and the eyelashes were very cheap and flimsy. Not happy with this product at all. People, if you want adhesive lash glue, order Kiss adhesive glue for $6.99. It's cheap and it last for a quite a while.

I've used other magnetic eyelashes and they worked great. This eyeliner is terrible and doesn't stay on even after letting it dry for five minutes.  The eyelashes wouldn't stick at all, so i tried it on the back of my hand and same results.  Please save your $$$ ..geometric is better.

These are the best and easiest lashes I have ever put on in my life. I am so in love and I will never buy anything else again. The creativity is on a billion by putting beauty and science together in such a brilliant way when you were creating this masterpiece!  Thank you

Almost gave up using false lashes.  Just couldn't get on.  These applied perfect 1st time!  Easy, easy, easy!  Shake the eyeliner alot.  My eyes are super sensitive so that was a worry, but no problems.  Extremely comfortable!

reviews.t: My Favorite Eye Lashes to Date
reviews.x: Man I’ve tried tons of false eyelashes and found these to be my favorite. No heavy magnets just nice eyeliner that keeps the lashes on till you take them off.
Love these so much easy to apply and holds better than magnetic lashes. Liner isn’t sticky after apply The lashes which is amazing can’t wait to get more!!!!
Adhesive liner is great. Lashes attach quickly and easily. Use makeup remover to take off liner. Can reuse each pair multiple times

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes easy to apply and use.
Several reviewers complain that the eyeliner dries out quickly or is already dry.
Some reviewers find the eyeliner hard to remove, requiring lots of rubbing.
A few reviewers report the lashes are stiff, sharp, or don't stay on well.
Reviewers praise the quality and value, with some calling them their favorite or go-to lashes.
